01 / ABOUT THE UNION BRIDGING SCHOOLS THROUGH TECHNOLOGY

ONE NETWORK. MANY MINDS.

HKJSTU brings together secondary school students from local and international schools across Hong Kong. We create opportunities to explore technology beyond the classroom—from coding and cybersecurity to digital design, engineering, and aviation technology.

Our mission is simple: bridge gaps between schools, empower young people, and create social impact through technology.

YOUR NEXTCHAPTERSTARTS HERE.

Membership is free and open to current secondary school students in Hong Kong. Whether you’re into software, design, engineering, or simply figuring out what excites you—there’s room to start.
